read.price_for_a_kept_holding: A dollar holding needs no price: analysis_dollars is the client's amount. A weight holding needs the reference notional and the weight reconciliation, both already in the template. A SHARES holding needs an exact-date USD quote with a canonical key (portfolio.py SHARES branch, prices from uploads.resolve_prices, from MDPF_SECHIST's price path). A KEPT symbol has no canonical key, so the freeze refuses it as SHARES_PRICE_UNAVAILABLE. Per the order, SHARES is a BLOCKING-scoped gap (see shares_status), and the dollar and weight bases are built.

state.verdicts: KEPT (verified: rows > 0 and a finite positive last close) -> KEPT state, cached for min(900 s, nothing longer than the NOT_FOUND TTL). NOT_KEPT -> the NOT_FOUND result, unchanged. CHECK_FAILED with reason EXCEPTION, TIMEOUT, PUSHBACK or ERROR_FRAME -> UNAVAILABLE reason YFINANCE_CHECK_FAILED with check_failed=reason, never NOT_FOUND. NOT_CHECKED (beyond the cap) -> UNAVAILABLE reason YFINANCE_NOT_CHECKED with not_checked=UPLOAD_LIMIT. A missing, malformed or unproven entry reads CHECK_FAILED ERROR_FRAME. A raised checker reads CHECK_FAILED EXCEPTION for every unknown symbol.
state.cache: A fresh provider NOT_FOUND is cached 900 s, as before. A cached NOT_FOUND is still served as a provider answer but does NOT end the lookup when a checker is present: the unknown step asks the checker about it, so it cannot hide a later KEPT (test_a_cached_not_found_does_not_hide_a_later_kept). A cached KEPT is served only when the resolver has a checker (test_a_cached_kept_is_never_served_without_the_checker). A KEPT is cached with expires_at = now + KEPT_TTL (900), so never longer than the NOT_FOUND it replaces (test_a_kept_is_cached_no_longer_than_the_not_found_ttl_and_served_inside_it).
state.batch: ONE checker.check call per resolver.check, with the distinct unknown symbols, so the cap of 10 is per upload (the cap itself is YfinanceChecker's, cap=10, pace 1.0 s, from yfinance_check.py of cell AR-y-292).

three_sentences_a_person_sees: TIMXX is not in our data provider but has price history, so it is used as it is.
XYZQ could not be checked just now (the price history service did not answer in time); name a proxy, or upload again in a few minutes.
ZZ11 was not checked in this upload (the limit is 10 unknown tickers per upload); name a proxy.

codes.TICKER_KEPT_BY_HISTORY: This ticker is not in our data provider but has price history, so it is used as it is.
codes.TICKER_CHECK_FAILED: We could not check this ticker with our price history service just now. Name a similar ticker to stand in for it (a proxy), or submit the request again in a few minutes.
codes.TICKER_NOT_CHECKED: This ticker was not checked in this upload, because only a limited number of unknown tickers are checked at once. Name a similar ticker to stand in for it (a proxy), or submit the request again.

reason_words.EXCEPTION: the price history service returned an error
reason_words.TIMEOUT: the price history service did not answer in time
reason_words.PUSHBACK: the price history service refused the request for now
reason_words.ERROR_FRAME: the price history service returned no usable answer
